<includeonly>{{#invoke:Infobox|main
|kind=dmz-dimension
|sep=,
|title={{#if:{{{title|}}}|{{{title}}}|{{#invoke:Labels|name}}}}
|image={{#invoke:Labels|image|{{{image|}}}}}
|caption={{{caption|}}}
|sections=Summary, General, Content

|Summary=Quote
|Summary_nolabel=yes
|Quote_nolabel=yes

|General=Gravity, Access, Biomes
|General_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|General}}
|Gravity_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Gravity}}
|Access_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Access}}
|Biomes_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Biomes}}

|Content=Resources, Inhabitants, Structures, Bosses
|Content_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Content}}
|Resources_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Resources}}
|Inhabitants_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Inhabitants}}
|Structures_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Structures}}
|Bosses_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Bosses}}
}}[[Category:Dimensions{{#translation:}}]]</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>
